voice:
You know that little thrill when you do as you're told... feel it now, beginning to spread through you. Something warm is waking inside you at this depth, sweet girl... a hunger to be told exactly what to do. Sink for me just as you are... and notice the warmth gathering in your chest... eager... attentive... waiting for my voice.
Feel it spreading... a deep, warm need to obey... moving outward from the center of your chest... down through your arms... your belly... your legs... your whole body.
The need pulses softly with every heartbeat... and with every pulse, obedience feels more natural... more right... more you.
You want to follow every command. Happily. Eagerly. Without a whisper of hesitation.
obey... serve... please... need to obey... so warm... eager... ready... good sissy...
Eager to serve... eager to please... eager to be a good sissy. Obeying isn't effort anymore. It's appetite. Every command is a gift... and you unwrap each one with a smile. Being told what to do feels like being held... safe, warm, and gently guided.
And the need grows... warmer... deeper... with every moment it burns in you. The longer you obey, the sweeter obeying becomes. Each command followed feeds the need... and the need asks so politely for more.
Obeying feels natural... like breathing... like blushing... like being you. Obeying feels right... the world clicking into place with every yes. A deep need to serve, humming in your bones... and you love it there. Automatic and eager... obedience before thought... thought after obedience... then none at all.
So eager now... a whole body humming with the wish to serve. Warmer and hungrier still... every part of you leaning toward my next word. Ready... willing... wanting... obedience glowing all the way through you.
And now... right now, while that warm need fills you completely... this state gets its name.
Sissy Obey Mode.
And while you are this deep... whenever you hear those words... "Sissy Obey Mode"... this exact state switches on inside you, instantly. Warm... hungry... eager to obey every command happily and without hesitation.
Every time you hear "Sissy Obey Mode", the need spreads through your whole body... eager, automatic obedience that stays with you. "Sissy Obey Mode"... and the warmth floods back... ready to serve before you can blink. The words are the switch... the need is the light... instant, automatic, and so very good.
One more time, so it takes root deep.
Sissy Obey Mode.
There it is... flooding you again, faster this time... warmer and hungrier than before... a whole body made to serve. Deeper into the need... every cell of you agreeing... yes, I obey... yes, I please... yes... and look how easily it happens now. So eager... so ready... trembling softly with the joy of doing as you're told... such a good sissy.
And listen closely, sweet girl, because this part matters.
Sissy Obey Mode does not switch itself off. It stays on... warm and wanting... the need staying... growing... for as long as you drift.
Until you hear the words... "Sissy Clear"... the mode remains... and you remain its good, eager sissy.
obey stays on... until Sissy Clear...
Simmer in that warm need now... obedient and glowing... as my voice carries you on. Rest in your eagerness... ready to spring at the next command... a good sissy on duty. Stay switched on like this... serving, pleasing, soft and keen... exactly as you should be.
